event.description: Tie the third-closest positional scalar pair
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,116 parameters at 99.050000%, a +0.050000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 6 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0063, the second positional scalar tie at 2,116 parameters and unchanged 99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0034, LayerNorm bias sharing. Recomputing over the 510 retained positional groups identifies representatives 181 and 302 as closest, with values -0.0032600686 and -0.0032589545, differing by 1.114e-6. Hypothesis: sharing their mean cumulatively with the two accepted pairs preserves qualification and yields 2,115 parameters. This is more informative than any other untested pair because it is the current minimum-distortion union under the retained table.
